title: Ralph Critique + Rework Mode
description: Add two new modes to Ralph: (1) critique mode where Jill reviews git diff after a PRD run and writes critique.md, (2) rework story support where Ralph reads an existing file and writes an improved version to a new output_file without touching the original.

userStories.title: Add type:rework support to prd_manager.py and prd_linter.py
userStories.description:
Extend the PRD story format to support a new story type: 'rework'. A rework story has additional required fields: target_file (file to read), output_file (new file to write), preserve (list of behaviors that must not change), and optionally current_behavior and desired_behavior strings. The prd_linter.py must validate that rework stories have these fields. prd_manager.py must pass target_file and output_file to the agent session context when running a rework story. The agent uses PROMPT-rework.md instead of PROMPT.md for rework stories.

Fields for type:rework stories:
- type: 'rework' (new value alongside existing implicit 'create')
- target_file: string — path to file to read (relative to repo root)
- output_file: string — path to write improved version (e.g. foo_v2.py)
- preserve: list of strings — behaviors that must exist in output_file
- current_behavior: string (optional) — description of current weaknesses
- desired_behavior: string (optional) — what the improved version should do
- acceptance_criteria: list of strings — test commands to run against output_file

Existing story fields (id, title, description, status, etc.) remain unchanged.

Do NOT change how type:create (or stories without a type field) work. Only add the new type.

userStories.title: Add --critique flag to ralph.sh
userStories.description:
Add a --critique flag to ralph.sh. When invoked as 'ralph.sh --critique <prd_dir>', the script:
1. Runs 'git diff HEAD' in the repo root and saves output to a temp file
2. Reads the PRD description from prd_dir/prd.json
3. Launches a Jill agent session (using claude-sonnet-4-6 via the openclaw API, not the local model) with PROMPT-critique.md as the system prompt
4. Passes the git diff and PRD description as the user message
5. Instructs the agent to write its output to prd_dir/critique.md
6. Exits 0 on success, 1 on failure

The critique agent uses PROMPT-critique.md (already written at ralph/PROMPT-critique.md).

Do NOT modify the existing ralph.sh loop logic. The --critique path is a separate branch that exits after the critique is written.
acceptance_criteria: critique.md contains the sections: '## ✅ What's Good', '## ⚠️ Improvements', '## 🔴 Must Rework'

userStories.title: Add REWORK-SPEC.md documenting the rework story format
userStories.description:
Write ralph/REWORK-SPEC.md that documents the rework story format for future reference.

The spec should document:
- What a rework story is (targeted improvement to a specific function/class)
- The fields: target_file, target_function, desired_behavior, preserve, acceptance_criteria
- The rule: always use edit_file (not write_file) for rework stories — edit only the function being improved
- Example rework story in JSON format

Keep it under 60 lines. Write it with write_file.
acceptance_criteria: File contains the word 'edit_file' at least once
